| Key activities          | • Assess the vulnerability of public health sector to climate change, identifying the current and future health effects and establishing early warning systems • Upgrade epidemiological surveillance to incorporate new health outcomes in the Epidemiological Surveillance Unit; • Develop a mechanism to incorporate climate data in the national health information system; • Develop health system response strategies, plans and projects and integrate them into national health strategies. |
extraction_rationale: This is a health-sector adaptation priority with specific system interventions (EWS, surveillance, climate-data integration).

parent_statement: Adaptation priorities
policy_statement: Reduce disaster risk from climate-related natural hazards and extreme weather by conducting multi-hazard risk assessments, updating flood/fire/drought risk maps, upgrading and developing a multi-hazard early warning platform, and coordinating updates to the national forest fire management strategy.
source_quote:
| Adaptation priority 7   | Reduce disaster risk and minimize damages by mitigating and adapting to climate- related natural hazards and extreme weather |
| Key activities          | • Conduct a multi-hazard risk assessment; • Update/revisit flood, fire and drought risk maps; • Upgrade and develop an early warning platform for multi-hazards; • Coordinate the updating of the National Forest fire management strategy. |
extraction_rationale: This is a disaster risk reduction/adaptation priority with concrete actions (risk assessment, maps, early warning platform, strategy update).

policy_statement: Reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 55% by 2030 (vs. 2008) and achieve carbon neutrality by 2050; bring forward energy carbon neutrality for public buildings to 2040.
source_quote: Today, inview of the climate change challenges that lie ahead, the City of Brussels is taking action by adopting a new Climate Plan with an even more ambitious long-term objective: a 55%reduction in greenhouse gas emissions by 2030, and carbon neutrality for the region by 2050. This objective of energy carbon neutrality has even been brought forward to 2040 for public buildings.
extraction_rationale: Contains quantified mitigation targets with deadlines (2030, 2050, 2040) and a defined scope (region; public buildings).

policy_statement: Strengthen the region's resilience to climate change (adaptation objective alongside mitigation targets).
source_quote: The Climate Plan defines ambitious quantified targets for the City of Brussels that will enable it  to  at  least  meet  the  commitments  set  out  in  the  Majority  Agreement,  the  Climate Emergency  Declaration  and  the  regional  and  European  targets  for  the  various  topics. It therefore  aims  to  reduce  greenhouse  gas  emissions  by  55%  by  2030,  achieve  carbon neutrality by 2050 and strengthen the region's resilience to climate change.
extraction_rationale: Explicit commitment to strengthen resilience; somewhat broad but clearly framed as a plan objective.

policy_statement: Reduce energy consumption of City of Brussels buildings by 40% compared with 2008 by 2030.
source_quote:
## 1. Energy efficiency in buildings and adapting to the effects of climate change

-  Reduce the energy consumption of City of Brussels buildings by 40% (compared with 2008).
extraction_rationale: Quantified energy-efficiency target with baseline year; clear policy commitment for municipal buildings.

policy_statement: Achieve an average EPC of C+ across City/CPAS-owned public heritage buildings (public authority buildings, crèches, schools, pools, sports centres, cultural venues).
source_quote:
To achieve the regional targets of energy neutrality for public buildings by 2040 and energy performance for private buildings by 2050, three intermediate targets have been set for the city's entire building stock:

o Public heritage buildings owned by the city and the Public Social Assistance Centre (CPAS) will achieve an average Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) of C+ for all public authority buildings, crèches, schools, swimming pools, sports centres and cultural venues.
extraction_rationale: Defines a specific performance standard (EPC C+) for a defined building portfolio; actionable and measurable.

policy_statement: Implement a renovation plan for social housing (SISP) stock so homes are renovated by 2030 to meet the regional objective of average EPC C+ by 2040.
source_quote: For  Social  housing  (SISP),  there  will  be  a  renovation  plan  for  its  stock  and homes will have been renovated according to the priorities set out in this plan by 2030 in order to meet the regional objective of achieving an average EPC level of C+ by 2040.
extraction_rationale: Commits to a specific intervention (renovation plan) with a timeline and performance linkage (EPC C+).

policy_statement: Downgrade the most energy-intensive homes (EPC F and G) owned by CPAS and the Régie Foncière by 2033.
source_quote: The most energy-intensive homes (EPC F and G) owned by the CPAS and the Régie Foncière will have been downgraded by 2033.
extraction_rationale: Time-bound commitment targeting worst-performing buildings; measurable via EPC ratings.

policy_statement: Reduce by at least 55% (vs. 2008) emissions linked to energy consumption of City Council, Régie, CPAS, and SISP public buildings by 2030.
source_quote: Compared  to  2008,  reduce  by  at  least  55%  all  emissions  linked  to  the  energy consumption of the public buildings of the City Council, the Régie, the CPAS and the SISPs by 2030.
extraction_rationale: Quantified GHG reduction target with baseline and deadline for a defined set of public buildings.

policy_statement: Enhance city flat roofs with climatic functions (PV, solar thermal, vegetation, bleaching, etc.) using the Living Roofs tool at design stage and implement recommendations for priority sites.
source_quote:
Enhance  the  city's  flat roofs where  this  is possible with  a climatic function (photovoltaic solar panels, solar thermal panels, vegetation, bleaching, etc.):

o Right  from the  design  stage  of  each  renovation  or  roofing  project,  the  City Council uses the "Living Roofs" tool, which identifies the climatic function(s) that can be allocated to the roofs of buildings.

o The City Council will implement the recommendations of the "Living Roofs" study for the priority sites identified which allow this and which do not require renovation work in the short term.
extraction_rationale: Specific operational requirement (use tool at design stage; implement study recommendations) and named interventions (PV, vegetation).

policy_statement: Propose to the region a 10% reduction in energy consumption by 2030 compared with 2008.
source_quote: The City Council is proposing to the region to reduce its energy consumption by 10% in 2030 compared with 2008.
extraction_rationale: Quantified target with baseline and deadline; framed as a regional (non-binding) objective proposed by the City.

policy_statement: Double regional photovoltaic production to 100 GWh/year, with the City Council contributing 6 GWh.
source_quote: Increase photovoltaic solar panel production in the region: The City Council is committed to making its own contribution to the regional objectives for renewable production and is proposing to the region that photovoltaic solar panel production be doubled, reaching 100 GWh per year, with the City Council contributing 6 GWh.
extraction_rationale: Quantified renewable energy generation target with explicit municipal contribution.

policy_statement: Supply 100% of electricity consumed by the city's public buildings from renewable energy produced in Belgium.
source_quote: Increase the proportion of energy consumed by the city's public buildings, the Régie, the CPAS and the SISP that comes from renewable energy produced in Belgium: 100% of the electricity  consumed  by  the  city's  public  buildings  comes  from  renewable  energy produced in Belgium.
extraction_rationale: Clear procurement/supply commitment with a 100% target; directly affects emissions from electricity use.

policy_statement: Develop at least one Positive Energy Neighbourhood.
source_quote: Develop one or more "Positive Energy Neighbourhoods": The city has at least one Positive Energy Neighbourhood.
extraction_rationale: Specific named intervention with a minimum quantity (at least one).

policy_statement: Develop an urban heating network in collaboration with Brussels Energy.
source_quote: Develop an urban heating network in the city in collaboration with Brussels Energy.
extraction_rationale: Specific infrastructure intervention (district heating network); implementation commitment though no numeric target.

policy_statement: Establish energy communities: at least one energy community and one collective self-consumption project in each city neighbourhood.
source_quote: Develop energy communities: At least one energy community and one collective selfconsumption project have been set up in each of the city's neighbourhoods.
extraction_rationale: Quantified minimum per neighbourhood; specific mechanism (energy communities and collective self-consumption).

policy_statement: Facilitate collective self-consumption projects in privately rented housing to combat energy poverty.
source_quote: The  City  of  Brussels  is  facilitating  the  implementation  of  collective  self-consumption projects in the private housing it rents out, in order to combat energy poverty.
extraction_rationale: Specific intervention (facilitation of collective self-consumption) with an explicit social objective; climate benefit via renewable/self-consumption.

policy_statement: Systematically use an environmental impact analysis tool (e.g., TOTEM) for City/Régie/CPAS/SISP construction and renovation projects by 2030 to integrate sustainability and reversibility principles.
source_quote: By 2030, with regard to the environmental impact of construction/renovation projects, an impact analysis tool such as TOTEM will be systematically used by the City, the Régie, the CPAS and the SISPs to integrate the principles of sustainability and reversibility.
extraction_rationale: Mandates systematic use of a named tool by a deadline; concrete procedural requirement affecting embodied impacts.

policy_statement: Adopt measures to reduce environmental impact of worksites and routinely analyse environmental impacts of two variants for construction/renovation projects across the region.
source_quote: The  City  Council  is  proposing  an  ambitious  target  for  the  environmental  impact  of construction/renovation projects throughout the region: The City Council will be adopting measures  to  reduce  the  environmental  impact  of  the  worksites  and  will  be  routinely analysing the environmental impact of the two variants.
extraction_rationale: Commits to adopting measures and routine analysis; somewhat vague on metrics but still a concrete operational commitment.

policy_statement: Develop a cross-cutting checklist of sustainability criteria (including circular economy) to integrate into upstream design of each renovation/construction project.
source_quote:
Incorporate the circular economy dimension (reversibility, flexibility, pooling, reuse, etc.) into construction and renovation projects right from the design stage. : The City Council

is committed to developing a cross-cutting checklist of sustainability criteria, including the circular economy dimension, which will be integrated into the upstream thinking of each renovation/construction project.
extraction_rationale: Specific instrument (checklist) to be developed and integrated into project design; supports circular construction.

policy_statement: Incorporate water management and biodiversity protection systems (e.g., green roofs, cisterns, permeability, nesting boxes, urban agriculture) from the design stage where conditions allow.
source_quote: From the design stage of construction and renovation projects, incorporate systems for managing water  and  protecting  biodiversity  where  conditions  allow  (e.g.  green  roofs, cisterns, valleys, permeability, nesting boxes, urban agriculture, etc.).
extraction_rationale: Specific design-stage requirement listing concrete measures; addresses resilience and ecosystem functions.

policy_statement: Incorporate the 10-Minute City ambition into urban planning and development by 2030 to improve quality of life.
source_quote: Urban planning and development incorporate the 10-Minute City ambition to improve the quality of life of the people of Brussels.
extraction_rationale: Planning commitment tied to a named concept (10-Minute City); supports reduced travel demand though not quantified here.

policy_statement: Routinely apply the STOP principle to prioritise walking, cycling/active micro-mobility, public transport, shared transport, then private cars.
source_quote: The  City  of  Brussels  routinely  applies  the  STOP  principle  (prioritising  the  different modes of transport and favouring them in the following order: walking, bicycles and active micro transport - scooters, skateboards, rollerblades, single-wheel transport, etc.), public transport, collective private transport - taxis, car-sharing, car-pooling and finally individual private transport, public transport, private collective transport, taxis, car-sharing, car-pooling and private individual transport).
extraction_rationale: Operational policy principle guiding transport/public space decisions; concrete prioritisation order.

policy_statement: Increase by 50% public space dedicated to public transport, active transport, living/meeting spaces and green spaces by 2030.
source_quote: The public space of 2030 is improved by increasing by 50% the public space dedicated to public transport, active transport, living/meeting spaces and green spaces.
extraction_rationale: Quantified spatial reallocation target; supports modal shift and urban greening.

policy_statement: Achieve mode share targets: cycling ~15% of journeys and walking 30% of journeys in the City of Brussels.
source_quote:
Walking, cycling and public transport are encouraged, easy and safe, and account for a large proportion of journeys in the City of Brussels: Cycling accounts for around 15% of journeys made in the City of Brussels. Walking
- accounts for 30% of all journeys.
extraction_rationale: Quantified modal share targets; measurable via travel surveys.

policy_statement: Increase public transport mode share to 30% of journeys in the City of Brussels.
source_quote: Public transport serves the whole area efficiently and will ensure that traffic flows smoothly, accounting for 30% of journeys in the City of Brussels.
extraction_rationale: Quantified mode share target; directly linked to transport emissions reduction strategy.

policy_statement: Reduce private motor vehicle trips to 25% of all journeys by 2030 (aligned with Good Move).
source_quote: Car traffic is reduced: Trips made by private motor vehicle now account for only a quarter of all journeys, in line with the ambition of the regional Good Move plan.
extraction_rationale: Quantified reduction in car mode share; clear mitigation lever.

policy_statement: Reduce traffic from conventional thermal combustion vehicles by 50% in favour of electric and hybrid vehicles by 2030.
source_quote: Traffic from conventional thermal combustion vehicles has fallen by 50% in favour of electric and hybrid vehicles.
extraction_rationale: Quantified fleet/traffic transition target; directly addresses transport emissions.

policy_statement: Reduce heavy goods vehicles in residential areas and around schools/crèches/sports halls.
source_quote: Fewer heavy goods vehicles in residential areas and around schools, crèches, sports halls, etc.
extraction_rationale: Directional but concrete freight-management objective; lacks numeric target but is a specific intervention area.

policy_statement: Support sustainable freight transport and distribution logistics through pilot schemes (logistics hubs).
source_quote:
Logistics hub: Support sustainable freight transport and distribution logistics through pilot schemes:

o The  City  Council  has  set  itself  the  objective  of  increasing  the  number  of sustainable logistics hubs, and of welcoming them to its territory in order to complete the regional network.

o The  City  Council  encourages  commercial  and  transport  operators  to  offer sustainable logistics solutions.
extraction_rationale: Umbrella initiative explicitly followed by sub-items describing actions; qualifies as a parent policy.

parent_statement: Support sustainable freight transport and distribution logistics through pilot schemes (logistics hubs).
policy_statement: Increase the number of sustainable logistics hubs and welcome them on City territory to complete the regional network.
source_quote:
Logistics hub: Support sustainable freight transport and distribution logistics through pilot schemes:

o The  City  Council  has  set  itself  the  objective  of  increasing  the  number  of sustainable logistics hubs, and of welcoming them to its territory in order to complete the regional network.
extraction_rationale: Specific sub-action under the logistics hub initiative; concrete infrastructure/network expansion commitment.

parent_statement: Support sustainable freight transport and distribution logistics through pilot schemes (logistics hubs).
policy_statement: Encourage commercial and transport operators to offer sustainable logistics solutions.
source_quote:
Logistics hub: Support sustainable freight transport and distribution logistics through pilot schemes:

o The  City  Council  encourages  commercial  and  transport  operators  to  offer sustainable logistics solutions.
extraction_rationale: Specific enabling action under the parent initiative; somewhat broad but still a defined commitment to encourage operator behavior.

policy_statement: By 2030, ensure over 90% of public authority home-to-work journeys use low-carbon modes (vs. 80% in 2019).
source_quote: A local authority that uses low-carbon modes of transport: By 2030, more than 90% of the public authority's home-to-work journeys will be made using low-carbon modes of transport, compared with 80% in 2019.
extraction_rationale: Quantified commuting target with baseline year; clear employer operational policy.

policy_statement: By 2030, establish a shared and co-managed fleet of vehicles across City Council, CPAS and para-communal non-profits.
source_quote: Based on similar needs and uses, streamline and pool vehicles within the various City of  Brussels  Council  entities  (Régie  Foncière,  CPAS,  SISP,  etc.):    By  2030,  the  City Council, CPAS and the para-communal non-profit organisations will have a shared and co-managed fleet of vehicles.
extraction_rationale: Specific operational fleet-management reform with deadline; supports emissions reduction through efficiency/pooling.

policy_statement: Reduce the City Council vehicle fleet by 20% vs. 2018 and share 70% of non-utility vehicles internally by 2030.
source_quote: The City Council is committed to reducing its fleet of vehicles by 20% compared with 2018, and to sharing 70% of non-utility vehicles internally.
extraction_rationale: Quantified fleet reduction and sharing targets with baseline year; measurable.

policy_statement: Transition to 100% low-carbon engines for the car fleet where alternatives exist.
source_quote: 100% of the car fleet uses a low-carbon engine, provided that the alternative exists.
extraction_rationale: Clear fleet technology commitment; conditionality noted but still a defined target.

policy_statement: Adopt a business travel policy preferring rail over air for trips under 8 hours and prefer environmentally-friendly modes for trips under 5 km where logistics allow.
source_quote: The City Council has a business travel policy and will give preference to rail over air for all train journeys of less than 8 hours. In addition, for every journey of less than 5 km, where logistics allow, the City Council will give preference to environmentally-friendly modes of transport.
extraction_rationale: Specific operational travel rules with thresholds; directly reduces travel emissions.

policy_statement: Reduce annual waste quantities per inhabitant and by professionals by 20% (aligned with regional targets).
source_quote: Overall 20% reduction in the quantities of waste produced annually per inhabitant and by professionals, in line with regional targets.
extraction_rationale: Quantified waste prevention target; measurable via waste statistics.

policy_statement: Reduce waste sent to the incinerator (white bags) by 30%.
source_quote: 30% reduction in waste sent to the incinerator (white bags).
extraction_rationale: Quantified diversion target; relevant given incineration emissions noted elsewhere in the chapter.

policy_statement: Reduce waste produced by City Council departments by 30%.
source_quote: 30% reduction in waste produced by the City Council departments.
extraction_rationale: Quantified internal waste reduction target; measurable.

policy_statement: From July 2023, stop serving food and drink prepared in single-use catering equipment at City Council activities and events it organises, and serve only mains water.
source_quote: In  line  with  the  Brussels-Capital  Region's  BRUDALEX  2.0,  from  July  2023  the  City Council will no longer serve food and drink prepared in single-use catering equipment, and will only serve mains water as part of its own activities and at events it organises.
extraction_rationale: Time-bound operational ban/requirement; concrete zero-waste measure.

policy_statement: Label 500 'welcome container' businesses in the city to support zero-waste solutions.
source_quote:
Shops offer 'zero waste' solutions:

Labelling of 500 welcome container businesses in the city.
extraction_rationale: Quantified programmatic action (labelling) supporting reuse/packaging reduction.

policy_statement: Promote sustainable businesses via 5 zero-waste routes around the city.
source_quote: The City  of  Brussels  is  committed  to  promoting  sustainable  businesses  via  5  zerowaste routes around the city (see existing routes).
extraction_rationale: Specific promotional intervention with a quantified number of routes.

policy_statement: Ensure each new City Council contract is geared towards a Zero Waste policy.
source_quote: The  City  Council  is  committed  to  ensuring  that  each  new  City  Council  contract  is geared towards a Zero Waste policy.
extraction_rationale: Procurement commitment affecting waste generation; concrete institutional lever though not quantified.

policy_statement: Provide re-use services (loan shops, repair cafés/shops, second-hand shops, etc.) in neighbourhoods in the spirit of the 10-Minute City.
source_quote: The city's neighbourhoods benefit from re-use services such as "loan shops", "repair cafés", repair shops, second-hand shops, flea markets, free markets, etc. in the spirit of the 10-Minute City.
extraction_rationale: Service provision commitment; supports circular economy though lacks numeric target.

policy_statement: Set up a waste recovery and reconditioning method at one of the city's markets.
source_quote: The City Council undertakes to set up a waste recovery and reconditioning method at one of the city's markets.
extraction_rationale: Specific operational intervention at markets; concrete and implementable.

policy_statement: Ensure 70% of bulky waste collected is recycled/upgraded/recovered directly by social economy actors.
source_quote: Increase the recycling and reuse of waste collected during bulky goods collections, in particular  by  parties  interested  in  the  social  economy:  70%  of  the  waste  collected during bulky goods collections is recycled, upgraded or recovered directly by parties interested in the social economy.
extraction_rationale: Quantified recycling/reuse target with specified delivery channel (social economy).

policy_statement: Sort 90% of waste collected during bulky goods collections.
source_quote: Increase  the  sorting  of  waste  collected  during  bulky  goods  collections:  90%  of  the waste collected during bulky goods collections is sorted.
extraction_rationale: Quantified operational sorting target; measurable.

policy_statement: Achieve 60% of household waste (by weight) ready for re-use and recycling.
source_quote: Improved sorting of household waste: 60% of the weight of household waste is ready for re-use and recycling  1 .
extraction_rationale: Quantified waste readiness target; measurable via composition/sorting metrics.

policy_statement: Achieve 70% of non-household waste (excluding construction waste) ready for re-use and recycling.
source_quote: Increase  in  the  proportion  of  non-household  waste  (excluding  construction  waste) ready for re-use and recycling: 70% of the weight of non-household waste (excluding construction waste) is suitable for re-use and recycling.
extraction_rationale: Quantified target for business/non-household waste; measurable.

policy_statement: Achieve 95% of construction waste ready for re-use and recycling.
source_quote: Increase in the proportion of construction waste ready for re-use and recycling: 95% of construction waste is ready for re-use and recycling.
extraction_rationale: Quantified construction waste circularity target; measurable.

policy_statement: Recover 100% of bio-waste produced by the city.
source_quote: Increase the recovery of bio-waste produced by the city: Recover 100% of the biowaste produced by the city.
extraction_rationale: Quantified recovery target; directly linked to reducing incineration and associated emissions.

policy_statement: Set up community composting facilities accessible to all residents and encourage individual composting as part of the 10-Minute City initiative.
source_quote:
Set up individual and collective composting facilities wherever possible:

As part of the 10-Minute City initiative, the City Council aims to set up community composting  facilities  accessible  to  all  Brussels  residents,  and  to  encourage  the development of individual composting facilities.
extraction_rationale: Specific intervention (community composting) with accessibility objective; implementation commitment though not quantified.

policy_statement: Reduce mains water consumption by 40% for building use and outdoor maintenance by identifying/treating all leaks and equipping public buildings with water storage where technically possible.
source_quote: Reduce our consumption of mains water by 40% in the use of buildings and in the maintenance of outdoor areas: The City Council has set itself the target of identifying and treating every leak in all of its buildings, as well as equipping all public buildings, where technically possible, with a water storage capacity equivalent to their needs for watering  plants,  sanitary  facilities,  road  cleaning,  vehicles  or  vegetable  gardens
extraction_rationale: Quantified reduction target plus concrete measures (leak treatment; storage capacity).

policy_statement: Equip the municipality with rainwater storage capacity covering the equivalent of 20 days' use (watering green spaces and cleaning).
source_quote: Equip the municipality with a rainwater storage capacity. Together, these installations will cover the equivalent of 20 days' use (watering green spaces and cleaning).
extraction_rationale: Quantified storage/service level target; supports drought resilience and reduced mains water use.

policy_statement: During renovation, equip public buildings with rainwater storage capacity equivalent to 20 days' use where conditions allow.
source_quote: During renovation, equip public buildings with rainwater storage capacity equivalent to 20 days' use, if conditions allow.
extraction_rationale: Specific requirement tied to renovation projects with a quantified storage target; conditional but concrete.

policy_statement: Increase access to drinking water by ensuring public drinking fountains are easily accessible in dense areas and near every sports ground and children's play area.
source_quote: Increase access to drinking water: Public drinking fountains will be easily accessible in densely  built-up  areas  and  in  the  immediate  vicinity  of  every  sports  ground  and children's play area.
extraction_rationale: Concrete service-access commitment; climate link is mainly heat/health resilience though not explicitly stated here.

policy_statement: Ensure 100% of roadworks in priority zones and upstream of flood-prone areas incorporate Integrated Stormwater Management (ISWM).
source_quote: Generalise  Integrated  Stormwater  Management  (ISWM)  during  public  works  in priority areas and upstream of them: The City Council is committed to ensuring that 100% of roadworks in priority intervention zones and upstream of flood-prone areas incorporate integrated rainwater management.
extraction_rationale: Binding-sounding commitment with a 100% coverage target; directly addresses flooding risk.

policy_statement: Permeabilise or disconnect from sewers at least 250,000 m² of impermeable surfaces in the priority intervention zone of the Molenbeek catchment area.
source_quote: The City Council is committed to permeabilising or disconnecting from the sewers at least  250,000m²  of  impermeable  surfaces  in  the  priority  intervention  zone  of  the Molenbeek catchment area.
extraction_rationale: Quantified area-based target; clear flood-risk reduction measure.

policy_statement: Ensure 100% of City Council projects in priority flood control zones incorporate integrated rainwater management measures.
source_quote: The City Council's projects in priority flood control zones include integrated rainwater management system projects: The City Council is committed to ensuring that 100% of its projects incorporate integrated rainwater management system measures.
extraction_rationale: 100% integration requirement; directly adaptation-focused.

policy_statement: Encourage at least 50 voluntary integrated rainwater management projects by local interested parties in priority zones via flood-control awareness campaigns and grants.
source_quote: The City Council will encourage the integration of integrated rainwater management system  intervention  for  all  projects  by  local  interested  parties  located  in  priority intervention zones: At least 50 integrated rainwater management system projects by local interested parties in priority intervention zones are carried out on a voluntary basis  (excluding  permit  obligations)  via  the  City  Council's  flood  control  awareness campaign, with the help of municipal and regional grants.
extraction_rationale: Quantified target (at least 50 projects) and explicit use of grants; clear adaptation policy.

policy_statement: Implement the blue network by creating a network of permeable, infiltrating water surfaces linked to the green network.
source_quote: The blue network will be implemented, creating a network of permeable, infiltrating water surfaces throughout the area, linked to the green network.
extraction_rationale: Named infrastructure/ecosystem network intervention; supports cooling and water management.

policy_statement: Increase the number of cool areas or recreational access to water in every neighbourhood, accessible within 10 minutes from any point in the city.
source_quote: Increase the number of cool areas or recreational access to water in every City of Brussels neighbourhood, accessible in less than 10 minutes from any point in the city.
extraction_rationale: Clear adaptation service/access objective tied to heat risk context; measurable via accessibility mapping.

policy_statement: Provide a natural open-air bathing area accessible in the City of Brussels region.
source_quote: A natural open-air bathing area will be accessible in the City of Brussels region.
extraction_rationale: Specific adaptation amenity linked to heatwaves in the chapter context; concrete deliverable.

policy_statement: Maintain good water quality in all ponds and (semi-)natural water areas via constant monitoring and an intervention procedure.
source_quote: Good water quality (in accordance with the European Water Framework Directive) will be maintained in all the ponds and (semi-) natural water areas: constant monitoring will be carried out and an intervention procedure will be defined and applied.
extraction_rationale: Operational commitment (monitoring + procedure) tied to a regulatory standard; climate link is indirect but supports resilient water systems.

policy_statement: Work with the Regional Council and municipalities in the same catchment to reduce sewage discharge into the canal and the Seine river.
source_quote: The City Council undertakes to do its utmost, in cooperation with the Regional Council and the municipalities in the same catchment area, to reduce the discharge of sewage into the canal and the Seine river.
extraction_rationale: Intergovernmental operational commitment; somewhat vague ('do its utmost') but still a stated undertaking.

policy_statement: Promote the use of city surfaces to encourage agro-ecology on city properties and in the surrounding region.
source_quote:
The City Council promotes the use of surfaces such as roofs, green spaces, existing agricultural land, gardens, etc. to encourage agro-ecology on city properties and in the surrounding region:

o 10  new  hectares  have  been  set  aside  for  agro-ecological,  open-ground professional farming on city land and/or property.

o 4 pilot projects will be set up in the city's green spaces.
extraction_rationale: Umbrella commitment followed by quantified sub-items; qualifies as a parent policy.

parent_statement: Promote the use of city surfaces to encourage agro-ecology on city properties and in the surrounding region.
policy_statement: Set aside 10 new hectares for agro-ecological, open-ground professional farming on city land and/or property.
source_quote:
The City Council promotes the use of surfaces such as roofs, green spaces, existing agricultural land, gardens, etc. to encourage agro-ecology on city properties and in the surrounding region:

o 10  new  hectares  have  been  set  aside  for  agro-ecological,  open-ground professional farming on city land and/or property.
extraction_rationale: Quantified land allocation commitment; concrete NBS/food-system intervention.

parent_statement: Promote the use of city surfaces to encourage agro-ecology on city properties and in the surrounding region.
policy_statement: Set up 4 pilot projects in the city's green spaces to encourage agro-ecology.
source_quote:
The City Council promotes the use of surfaces such as roofs, green spaces, existing agricultural land, gardens, etc. to encourage agro-ecology on city properties and in the surrounding region:

o 4 pilot projects will be set up in the city's green spaces.
extraction_rationale: Specific pilot-project commitment with a number (4).

policy_statement: Increase the number of professionals working in urban agriculture and explore training provision.
source_quote:
Increase the number of professionals working in the field of urban agriculture:

o The City Council is proposing to double the number of professionals working in the field of urban agriculture.

o The city will look into the possibility of developing the provision of training leading to qualifications in horticulture and market gardening.
extraction_rationale: Umbrella objective with sub-items; includes a quantified target and a concrete capacity-building action.

parent_statement: Increase the number of professionals working in urban agriculture and explore training provision.
policy_statement: Propose doubling the number of professionals working in urban agriculture.
source_quote:
Increase the number of professionals working in the field of urban agriculture:

o The City Council is proposing to double the number of professionals working in the field of urban agriculture.
extraction_rationale: Quantified workforce target; supports local production and potentially lower-carbon food systems.

parent_statement: Increase the number of professionals working in urban agriculture and explore training provision.
policy_statement: Look into developing training leading to qualifications in horticulture and market gardening.
source_quote:
Increase the number of professionals working in the field of urban agriculture:

o The city will look into the possibility of developing the provision of training leading to qualifications in horticulture and market gardening.
extraction_rationale: Concrete capacity-building action, though phrased as exploratory ('look into'); still a stated action.

policy_statement: Eliminate the use of synthetic pesticides in the city.
source_quote: Synthetic pesticides are no longer used in the city.
extraction_rationale: Clear prohibition/phase-out statement; supports biodiversity and ecosystem resilience.

policy_statement: Source at least 50% of fruit and vegetables purchased by the City from local production channels (subject to procurement rules) contributing to EU Farm to Fork objectives.
source_quote: With  a  view  to  reterritorialization,  and  if  current  European  regulations  on  public procurement allow, at least 50% of the fruit and vegetables purchased by the City of Brussels come from local production channels and contribute to the objectives of the European Farm To Fork strategy.
extraction_rationale: Quantified procurement target with conditionality; climate relevance indirect via food-system emissions and supply chains.

policy_statement: Double the number of local producers and artisans at city markets and prioritise permits for local producers and artisans.
source_quote: Develop local sources for the city's markets: Double the number of local producers and artisans at the city's markets. The town gives priority to providing permits to local producers and artisans.
extraction_rationale: Quantified market-sourcing target plus a permitting preference mechanism.

policy_statement: Propose that the region reach 50 Good Food shops.
source_quote: Increase the number of Good Food and bulk products on offer in the city: The city is proposing that the region should have 50 Good Food shops.
extraction_rationale: Quantified target proposed to the region; indirect climate link via sustainable food systems.

policy_statement: Propose that the region reach 100 Good Food label restaurants.
source_quote: Increase the number of Good Food restaurants: The city is proposing that the region reach 100 restaurants with the Good Food label.
extraction_rationale: Quantified target proposed to the region; supports lower-impact food offerings.

policy_statement: Propose launching at least 5 neighbourhood kitchens in the city.
source_quote: Encourage  "neighbourhood  kitchens"  throughout  the  city:  The  City  Council  is proposing to the region to launch at least 5 "neighbourhood kitchens" in the city.
extraction_rationale: Quantified program proposal; climate link indirect (food access and potentially reduced waste).

policy_statement: Set up logistics hubs in the city to pool deliveries and/or waste management and support logistics resources for sustainable food operators.
source_quote:
Setting up logistics hubs in the city:

o At least one logistics hub within the city, with the aim of pooling deliveries and/or waste management.

o The City Council undertakes to support logistical resources or tools dedicated to the pooling of sustainable food operators in shopping districts.
extraction_rationale: Umbrella initiative with sub-items; concrete logistics interventions.

parent_statement: Set up logistics hubs in the city to pool deliveries and/or waste management and support logistics resources for sustainable food operators.
policy_statement: Establish at least one logistics hub within the city to pool deliveries and/or waste management.
source_quote:
Setting up logistics hubs in the city:

o At least one logistics hub within the city, with the aim of pooling deliveries and/or waste management.
extraction_rationale: Quantified minimum (at least one hub) with defined purpose (pooling).

parent_statement: Set up logistics hubs in the city to pool deliveries and/or waste management and support logistics resources for sustainable food operators.
policy_statement: Support logistical resources/tools dedicated to pooling sustainable food operators in shopping districts.
source_quote:
Setting up logistics hubs in the city:

o The City Council undertakes to support logistical resources or tools dedicated to the pooling of sustainable food operators in shopping districts.
extraction_rationale: Specific support commitment; lacks quantification but is a defined intervention.

policy_statement: Invite the region to double the number of citizen initiatives for sustainable food procurement groups.
source_quote: Increase the number of citizen initiatives for sustainable food procurement groups: The City Council is inviting the region to increase by a factor of 2 the number of citizen initiatives for sustainable procurement groups.
extraction_rationale: Quantified scaling target (factor of 2) proposed to region; indirect climate link.

policy_statement: Achieve a flexitarian diet outcome: 50% of residents eat meat 4 days/week or less (vs. 36% in 2020).
source_quote: Promoting the flexitarian diet to the people of Brussels: 50% of Brussels residents eat meat 4 days a week or less (36% in 2020).
extraction_rationale: Quantified behavioural outcome target with baseline; directly relevant to food-related emissions.

policy_statement: Ensure City facilities' food meets Good Food criteria: meals served by Cuisines Bruxelloises are 100% organic, meat reduced to 60% without increasing red meat, and vegetarian menus 3 days out of 5.
source_quote: The food served in the city's facilities fully complies with Good Food criteria: In line with  ONE's  nutritional  recommendations  and  the  Federal  Plan  for  Nutrition  and Health, the meals served by the Cuisines Bruxelloises to the City (schools, crèches, etc.) are 100% organic, have reduced the amount of meat to 60% (previously 50%), without increasing the proportion of red meat, and the menus are vegetarian 3 days out of 5.
extraction_rationale: Specific, measurable procurement/menu standards; strong mitigation relevance via dietary shift.

policy_statement: Host three zero-waste markets by 2030 and conduct awareness-raising campaigns to promote bulk and organic products.
source_quote: Encourage the development of "bulk" and "organic" products in the city's markets: The city is committed to hosting three zero-waste markets in its region by 2030, and to conducting awareness-raising campaigns.
extraction_rationale: Quantified commitment (three markets) with deadline; supports packaging reduction and sustainable consumption.

policy_statement: Reduce food waste by 50% by 2030 starting with City infrastructure and encourage Cuisines Bruxelloises clients in the city region to do the same.
source_quote: Reduce food waste within the city's  infrastructure:  Reduce food  waste by  50% by 2030, starting with the City of Brussels' infrastructure, and encourage the clients of the Cuisines Bruxelloises located in the city's region to do the same.
extraction_rationale: Quantified reduction target with deadline and defined starting scope; mitigation via avoided waste emissions.

policy_statement: Call on the region to reduce food waste by 50% by 2030.
source_quote: Operate a business within the City of Brussels. The city is calling  on  the  region to reduce food waste by 50% by 2030.
extraction_rationale: Quantified target proposed/called for at regional level; wording is awkward but contains a clear call for a 50% reduction by 2030.

policy_statement: Recover at least 100 tons of surplus/unsold food every year.
source_quote: Increased food recovery from food surpluses/unsold food: At least 100 tons of surplus food are recovered every year.
extraction_rationale: Quantified annual recovery target; reduces waste-related emissions and supports social outcomes.

policy_statement: Develop a differentiated management system for green spaces meeting 'Réseau Nature' criteria and label all city green spaces by 2030.
source_quote:
Develop a differentiated management system for green spaces, meeting the criteria of  the  "Réseau  Nature"  label,  i.e.  absence  of  synthetic  pesticides,  preservation  of natural  environments,  diversity  of  wildlife,  priority  given  to  indigenous  plants  and combatting invasive exotic species.

o 100% of the city's green spaces to be labelled Réseau Nature by 2030.
extraction_rationale: Umbrella biodiversity management policy with a quantified coverage target (100% by 2030).

parent_statement: Develop a differentiated management system for green spaces meeting 'Réseau Nature' criteria and label all city green spaces by 2030.
policy_statement: Label 100% of the city's green spaces as Réseau Nature by 2030.
source_quote:
Develop a differentiated management system for green spaces, meeting the criteria of  the  "Réseau  Nature"  label,  i.e.  absence  of  synthetic  pesticides,  preservation  of natural  environments,  diversity  of  wildlife,  priority  given  to  indigenous  plants  and combatting invasive exotic species.

o 100% of the city's green spaces to be labelled Réseau Nature by 2030.
extraction_rationale: Quantified certification target; measurable and time-bound.

policy_statement: Map and develop the city's green network by 2030 to complement the regional network, including new green spaces and greening (trees, shrubs, climbing plants, green roofs) and identifying priority migration corridors.
source_quote:
Develop  the  City  of  Brussels'  green  network  -  connected  to  the  regional  green network, integrating flora and fauna. Creation of a green network will be carried out in conjunction with local operators, while respecting third party rights:

o By  2030,  the  city's  green  network  will  be  mapped  and  developed  to complement the regional network, for example by creating new green spaces and  greening  wherever  possible  with  trees  and  shrubs  in  public  spaces, climbing plants and green roofs. Priority migration corridors will have been identified,  giving  rise  to  new  measures  to  promote  biodiversity  and  species migration.
extraction_rationale: Umbrella network initiative with detailed sub-elements; time-bound (by 2030) and concrete measures.

policy_statement: Ensure every resident has access to a local green space or park within 10 minutes by completing the green network.
source_quote: Complete the green network so that every resident has access to a local green space or park within 10 minutes.
extraction_rationale: Accessibility standard tied to green infrastructure; supports heat resilience and wellbeing though hazard not stated here.

policy_statement: Develop 2 pilot projects to protect nocturnal biodiversity while guaranteeing a sense of security.
source_quote: Preserving  biodiversity:  developing  2  pilot  projects  aimed  at  protecting  nocturnal biodiversity while guaranteeing a sense of security.
extraction_rationale: Specific pilot commitment with a number (2); climate link indirect.

policy_statement: Continue the Neder-Over-Hembeek Urban Forest project to create an extensive biodiversity conservatory.
source_quote: Continuing  the  Neder-Over-Hembeek  Urban  Forest  project  to  create  an  extensive biodiversity conservatory.
extraction_rationale: Named nature-based project continuation; supports ecosystem resilience.

policy_statement: Adopt and ensure compliance with a tree charter for appropriate species selection, planting, and respectful management, and encourage local operators to align.
source_quote:
Adopt and ensure compliance with a tree charter aimed at all local operators, so that the right species can be planted in the right places and in the right way, and these trees can be managed with respect. Integrate these principles as early as possible in the project and throughout the life of the trees to maximise all the possible benefits of the plantations.

o Suggest to local operators that they join in the city's objectives by respecting the same criteria in the management of private trees.
extraction_rationale: Umbrella governance instrument (tree charter) with compliance intent and outreach to other operators; concrete policy tool.

policy_statement: Plant 8 trees for each new-born child registered, in deforestation-sensitive areas in UN-recognised developing countries, to increase carbon sinks.
source_quote: To increase carbon sinks, the City of Brussels is committed to planting 8 trees for each new-born child registered in its population registers in deforestation-sensitive areas in countries recognised by the UN as "Developing Countries".
extraction_rationale: Quantified nature-based sequestration commitment with a clear mechanism (tree planting per birth).

policy_statement: Incorporate biodiversity criteria into sustainable procurement strategy for goods/services and into Cuisines Bruxelloises food contracts to combat global ecosystem erosion.
source_quote: The  city  is  helping  to  combat  the  erosion  of  ecosystems  on  a  global  scale  by incorporating biodiversity criteria into its sustainable procurement strategy for goods and services, and into the Cuisines Bruxelloises food contracts.
extraction_rationale: Procurement policy lever with explicit biodiversity criteria; climate relevance indirect via ecosystem integrity.

policy_statement: Combat urban heat islands using vegetation-first approaches and implement pilot projects.
source_quote:
The city is combatting heat islands in public spaces and buildings.

o The city is committed to carrying out 3 pilot projects to reduce the urban heat island phenomenon.

o The city is committed to using vegetation as the first solution to combat heat.
extraction_rationale: Umbrella adaptation/NBS initiative with explicit sub-actions and quantified pilots.

policy_statement: Ensure all City-funded and City-dependent cultural venues have an action plan aligned with area climate objectives, including low-carbon transport solutions, Good Food catering, local sourcing (including local currency), and reduced energy consumption.
source_quote:
The city undertakes to ensure that all cultural venues (museums, theatres and cultural centres) that are funded and directly dependent on the City Council have put in place an action plan designed to meet the area's climate objectives, and to make all other cultural venues in the area aware of the need to have an action plan. This action plan includes the following objectives:
- o Routinely  proposing  transport  solutions  so  that  travel  linked  to  cultural activities is carried out using low-carbon transport.
- o An increase in the catering offering that meets the "Good Food" criteria.
- o Promoting local sourcing among cultural operators directly dependent on the City  of  Brussels  Council,  in  particular  through  the  use  of  a  local  Brussels currency.
- o Reduced energy consumption.
extraction_rationale: Institutional requirement for action plans with specified components; concrete governance mechanism for emissions reduction.

policy_statement: Ensure 100% of City-organised events comply with BME sustainability action plan; require events on City territory to comply with mandatory sustainable event charter criteria and have 50% go further via non-mandatory recommendations (transport, food, waste, energy).
source_quote:
The City Council undertakes to ensure that 100% of the events organised by the City Council  comply  with  the  BME's  sustainability  action  plan,  and  that  the  events organised on the City's territory comply with the mandatory criteria of the sustainable event charter and 50% propose to go further via non-mandatory recommendations. These action plans focus in particular on:
- o Transport: using promotion and facilitation measures  to increase the proportion of visitors travelling with a low-carbon solution.
- o Food: a routine vegetarian formula for Horeca offerings.
- o Waste:  increased  routine  sorting  of  organic,  plastic/PMC,  cardboard  and residual waste; widespread availability of reusable crockery.
- o Reduced energy consumption.
extraction_rationale: Quantified compliance requirements (100%, 50%) with specified thematic measures; clear policy for event sustainability.

policy_statement: Double the number of tourists arriving by train and double cycle tourists through promotion/facilitation measures; double Green Key-certified tourist accommodations.
source_quote:
Transport:  while  maintaining  its  attractiveness  to  tourists  from  all  over  the  world, increase,  through  promotion  and  facilitation  measures,  the  proportion  of  tourist travel  using  a  low-carbon  solution  to  reach  twice  as  many  tourists  who  come  to Brussels by train and twice as many cycle tourists.

-  Double the number of tourist accommodations with "Green Key" certification.
extraction_rationale: Quantified doubling targets for low-carbon tourism travel and certified accommodations; direct mitigation relevance for tourism emissions.

policy_statement: Develop and support user-saving services across the region as part of the 10-Minute City approach (carsharing, digital access, equipment loans, coworking/sharing spaces).
extraction_rationale: Umbrella program with enumerated sub-actions; supports reduced resource use and potentially reduced travel demand.

The City Council is developing and supporting the development of user-saving services throughout its region, in particular for as many neighbourhoods as possible, as part of the "10-Minute City" approach:

policy_statement: Develop coworking and sharing spaces, including pooling municipal public buildings based on feasibility studies and integrating pooling options into new projects.
source_quote:
Coworking and sharing spaces:

 Between now and 2030, the City Council is committed to developing the  pooling  of  municipal  public  buildings  for  other  complementary functions  during  the  periods  when  they  are  not  in  use,  following  a feasibility study on all of its assets. In addition, new (construction/renovation) projects will routinely take into account the options for pooling.

 The City Council is proposing to the region that it develop its offering of shared spaces.
extraction_rationale: This sub-list itself contains multiple commitments; treated as a parent because it has distinct bullet sub-actions.

policy_statement: Promote and support access to second-hand products, including certification and annual targets.
source_quote:
Promoting and supporting access to second-hand products:

o The City Council is committed to promoting second-hand initiatives (certification, sales route).

o Continue to support re-use in the redevelopment of shopfronts, and to provide information and recommendations on sustainability.

policy_statement: Promote local currency (Zinne) by increasing acceptance among public facilities/events and proposing regional uptake among businesses.
source_quote:
Promoting local currency: increasing the number of service providers accepting the local currency Zinne in the City of Brussels.

o The City Council is committed to ensuring that 10 new public facilities (swimming pools, museums, sports halls, etc.) and events in the city accept the Zinne.

o The City Council is proposing to the region to develop the use of the Zinne among 400 businesses.
extraction_rationale: Umbrella initiative with quantified sub-targets (10 facilities; 400 businesses). Climate link is peripheral but included as part of transition policy.

policy_statement: Propose tripling the number of businesses with environmental certification in the region by 2019 and promote certifications and awarded companies.
source_quote:
Increase in the number of companies with environmental certification in the region (eco-dynamic company, Green Key, Zinne, Good Food, welcome containers, etc.)

o The City Council is proposing that the region should achieve a target of three times as many businesses with environmental certification in the region by 2019.

o The City Council undertakes to promote these certifications and the companies awarded them.
extraction_rationale: Contains a quantified target (though the year 2019 appears inconsistent with the plan timeline) and a promotion commitment; climate relevance indirect/peripheral.

policy_statement: Organise job placement for new professions required for the climate transition in collaboration with regional bodies.
source_quote: In  collaboration  with  the  Regional  Council,  the  COCOF  and  the  VGC,  organise  job placement in the new professions required for the climate transition.
extraction_rationale: Specific capacity-building/implementation measure supporting transition workforce; climate relevance indirect.

policy_statement: By end of 2022, ensure all childcare facilities managed by the City Council are eco-crèches.
source_quote: Aware of the environmental impact of childcare environments and the consequences of various forms of environmental pollution on children, the City Council launched the eco-crèche concept in 2019. By the end of 2022, all childcare facilities managed by the City Council will be eco-crèches.
section_header: 1. A resilient living environment from day one
extraction_rationale: Time-bound commitment with a defined scope (City-managed childcare facilities).

policy_statement: Generalise washable nappies in 100% of eco-crèches.
source_quote: Aiming for zero waste wherever possible, in particular through the zero PMC objective (tap water, replacement of single-use plastic shawls and booties with shawls and booties made  by  seamstresses,  limiting  the  purchase  of  new  plastic  toys  and  games,  etc.), recycling food waste, generalising the use of washable nappies in 100% of eco-crèches.
extraction_rationale: Specific operational measure with a 100% coverage target; reduces waste and associated emissions.

policy_statement: Install rainwater recovery systems in schools with vegetable gardens and equip all school buildings with water fountains.
source_quote:
Develop sustainable water management initiatives in schools (drinking fountains, water bottles, rainwater tanks, infiltration and flooding zones in courtyards, etc.).

o The  City  Council  is  committed  to  installing  rainwater  recovery  systems  in schools with vegetable gardens.

o The City Council is committed to equipping all its school buildings with water fountains.
extraction_rationale: Concrete infrastructure commitments for schools; supports water resilience and reduced mains water use.

policy_statement: Ensure 100% of schools have a School Travel Plan by 2030.
source_quote:
Continue  to  develop  School  Travel  Plans  within  our  schools,  with  the  support  of  the regional council, to encourage and organise environmentally-friendly transport for staff and pupils (pedestrian routes, safe use of bicycles, bicycle shelters, etc.).

o 100% of schools will have a School Travel Plan by 2030, with the support of the regional council.
extraction_rationale: Quantified coverage target with deadline; supports modal shift for school travel.

policy_statement: Extend orange bins to all schools and compost in key areas where possible to improve sorting and move toward zero waste.
source_quote:
Continue  and  further  improve  waste  sorting,  involving  both  staff  and  children/young people, with the aim of achieving zero waste.

o The City Council is committed to extending the use of orange bins in all its schools, and composting in key areas where possible.
extraction_rationale: Concrete operational commitments for school waste systems; supports waste diversion.

policy_statement: Train and raise awareness of climate issues among City Council staff and inform all new employees of climate issues relevant to their role upon starting work.
source_quote:
The departments are developing skills to implement actions that meet the objectives of the climate plan:

o Training,  empowering  and  raising  awareness  of  climate  issues  among  City Council staff in relation to their respective functions/departments.

o All new employees are informed of the climate issues relevant to their role as soon as they start work.
extraction_rationale: Concrete capacity-building commitments; supports implementation of climate plan across departments.

policy_statement: Apply for maximum available European, regional and FWB subsidies for investments linked to climate objectives.
source_quote: For  its  investments  linked  to  climate  objectives,  the  City  Council  is  applying  for  a maximum of European, regional and FWB subsidies, etc.
extraction_rationale: Explicit finance/means-of-implementation commitment to mobilize external funding for climate investments.

policy_statement: Strengthen and diversify ethical, socially responsible and sustainable investments.
source_quote: Strengthen and diversify ethical, socially responsible and sustainable investments.
extraction_rationale: Financial policy commitment (investment strategy) though not quantified; qualifies as a financial instrument direction.

policy_statement: Use taxation to encourage virtuous behaviour contributing to the transition and discourage behaviour harmful to the climate.
source_quote: The  City  Council  is  committed  to  using  taxation  as  a  tool  to  encourage  virtuous behaviour  that  contributes  to  the  transition  and  to  discourage  behaviour  that  is harmful to the climate.
extraction_rationale: Explicit commitment to deploy tax policy as an incentive/disincentive instrument; details unspecified but clearly a fiscal tool.

policy_statement: Make public procurement more sustainable by incorporating ecological, social and ethical clauses and developing/monitoring a sustainable procurement strategy with training.
source_quote:
Public procurement contracts meet sustainable procurement criteria, incorporating ecological, social and ethical clauses.

o The City Council, via the Procurement & Facilities department, will develop a sustainable  procurement  strategy.  Among  other  things,  this  will  help  guide agents towards the objectives  and  overriding  criteria  to  be  included  in  the special specifications.

o The  city  is  committed  to  monitoring  its  public  procurement  contracts  to measure their effectiveness and the relevance of their sustainable criteria.
extraction_rationale: Umbrella procurement reform with multiple concrete components; qualifies as a parent due to multiple sub-commitments in the quote.

policy_statement: Carry out an annual carbon assessment and develop a regional resilience diagnosis to identify vulnerabilities and reduce them.
source_quote: The City Council has carried out an annual carbon assessment and has developed a regional  resilience  diagnosis  that  enables  it  to  identify  its  vulnerabilities  and  take action to reduce them.
extraction_rationale: Monitoring and diagnostic commitments supporting mitigation and adaptation; concrete recurring assessment.

policy_statement: Monitor Climate Plan objectives continuously with indicators; present progress and carbon footprint annually to the College and publicly every two years via citizen governance.
source_quote: The strategic objectives of the Climate Plan have been continuously monitored using a wide range of indicators. The progress of the actions monitored and the authority's carbon  footprint  are  presented  annually  by  the  Management  Committee  to  the College, and every two years publicly in conjunction with the Climate Plan's citizen governance process.
extraction_rationale: Defines a concrete monitoring and reporting regime with specified frequencies; governance mechanism for accountability.

policy_statement: Monitor 100% of climate objectives via a single platform for the entire authority linked to the City Council's various plans.
source_quote: 100% of the  climate  objectives  are  monitored  via  a  single  platform  for  the  entire authority, linked to the City Council's various plans.
extraction_rationale: Concrete digital/management system commitment with a 100% coverage target.

policy_statement: Develop a Green IT strategy and reduce the carbon footprint of digital activity by 20% compared to 2019.
source_quote:
Developing a Green IT strategy to enable the development of a digital business.

o The City Council's Green IT strategy has reduced the carbon footprint of digital activity by 20% compared to 2019.
extraction_rationale: Named strategy with quantified carbon-footprint reduction target and baseline year.

policy_statement: Set up a Local Climate Assembly to steer achievement of Climate Plan objectives and ensure transparent monitoring, emissions identification, and adaptation actions.
source_quote: In 2030, the strategic objectives of the Climate Plan will be achieved thanks to the steering  of  a Local  Climate  Assembly made  up  of  representatives  from  the  City Council, the academic sector and local interested parties (businesses, local committees,  schools,  associations,  citizens,  etc.).  Linked  to  the  regional  Citizens' Climate Assembly, the Local Climate Assembly ensures transparent monitoring and sharing  of  the  actions  carried  out  in  the  area,  by  identifying  the  CO2  emissions produced by all the players in the area, as well as the actions aimed at better adapting the area to climate change.
extraction_rationale: Creates a governance body with defined composition and functions; directly tied to achieving climate objectives.

parent_statement: Set up a Local Climate Assembly to steer achievement of Climate Plan objectives and ensure transparent monitoring, emissions identification, and adaptation actions.
policy_statement: Entrust the Local Climate Assembly with three tasks: complete the roadmap for regional objectives, monitor/evaluate the plan, and unite/lead the network around climate objectives.
extraction_rationale: Defines concrete delegated functions under the parent governance initiative; extracted as parent because it contains multiple sub-tasks.

policy_statement: Extend the Call for Climate Projects throughout the year and adapt green grants to speed up implementation of climate projects in the region.
source_quote: The City Council is extending the Call for Climate Projects throughout the year, and adapting the types of green grants to meet the climate challenges and speed up the implementation of climate projects in the region.
extraction_rationale: Explicit grant program adjustment and extension; qualifies as a financial instrument supporting climate action.

policy_statement: Establish a Future Generations Council of young people to anchor the Climate Plan in future generations' vision and develop concrete proposals/actions in dialogue with the Brussels Climate Assembly.
source_quote: The city is home to a "Future Generations Council" made up of young people from the area, whose role is to ensure that the city's Climate Plan is permanently anchored in  the  vision  of  future  generations.  In  an  open  and  concerted  dialogue  with  the Brussels  Climate  Assembly,  this  Council  brings  out  concrete  proposals  and  actions from and/or managed by the future generation.
extraction_rationale: Creates a formal governance body with a defined role and outputs; supports sustained climate policy implementation.

policy_statement: Reduce Budapest's greenhouse gas emissions by at least 40% by 2030 compared to the 2015 base year.
source_quote:
Accordingly, the Municipality of Budapest has set the target to reduce its emissions by 40% by 2030 compared to the base year of 2015.

Chart 2: The decarbonisation target of Budapest

policy_statement: Reduce Budapest's greenhouse gas emissions by at least 80% by 2050 compared to 1990 and/or reduce per-capita annual emissions below 2 metric tons by joining the Under 2 Coalition.
source_quote: In addition to the foregoing, the Municipality of Budapest has also assumed a long-term commitment by joining the Under 2 Coalition 8 . section_header: 4.1.   REDUCTION OF THE EMISSION OF GREENHOUSE GASES (MITIGATION)
extraction_rationale: This is an explicit long-term quantified mitigation commitment tied to a formal coalition pledge.

policy_statement: Má-1: Improve energy efficiency of buildings/industry/tertiary sector and increase the share of renewables.
source_quote:
## Má -1 Improving the energy efficiency of buildings, industrial production and facilities of the tertiary sector and increasing the ratio of renewables:

- M1 -Energetic  refurbishment  and  energy  conscious  operation  of  the  buildings  of  the  Municipality  of Budapest and business associations providing public services

M2 -Energy efficient reconstruction of the public lighting system
