policy_statement: Lead by example by supporting land uses, buildings, systems, and technologies that promote water conservation and efficient energy use, and build and take advantage of cost-effective technologies that improve economic and environmental competitiveness.
source_quote: We plan on leading by example in supporting, embracing and celebrating land uses, buildings, systems, and technologies that promote water conservation and efficient energy use. We plan on building and taking advantage of the latest cost-effective technologies that support our economic and environmental competitiveness.
extraction_rationale: This is a stated municipal commitment (“We plan on…”) to implement specific interventions (water conservation, efficient energy use, cost-effective technologies). While not quantified, it is an actionable policy direction for city operations and development decisions.

policy_statement: Approach stormwater management as a connected and integrated element of city physical design, especially in new development and redevelopment.
source_quote: Stormwater and flood control systems are vital to a well-functioning city. As such, we need to approach stormwater management as a connected and integrated element of the physical design of our city.
extraction_rationale: Commits to an integrated stormwater management approach tied to development/redevelopment—an adaptation/resilience policy even without numeric targets.

policy_statement: Plan for a future that uses smart systems and technology to sustainably use water and energy.
source_quote: We need modern and efficient utilities to prosper. We are planning for a future that will use smart systems and technology to revolutionize the way we sustainably use our water and energy.
extraction_rationale: A forward-looking commitment to deploy smart utility systems explicitly tied to sustainable water and energy use; actionable infrastructure/technology direction.

policy_statement: Determine and implement the most effective ways to be stewards of the environment as the city grows.
source_quote: Maintaining the integrity of our natural environment means we have a goal of determining and implementing the most effective ways to be stewards of our environment, as our city grows.
extraction_rationale: Contains an explicit goal to determine and implement stewardship actions; somewhat vague on mechanisms but still a policy commitment anchored by implementation language.

policy_statement: Proactively invest, adapt, and establish programs for sustainability and resiliency to address vulnerability of natural landscapes to hazards, degradation, and overuse.
source_quote: We need to recognize their vulnerability from natural hazards, degradation, and overuse. This requires continuing to proactively invest, adapt, and establish programs for sustainability and resiliency.

extraction_rationale: Commits to proactive investment and programs to improve resilience of natural landscapes; adaptation-oriented with clear action verbs though not budgeted.

extraction_rationale: A clear commitment (“We plan to…”) to integrate creek corridors for stormwater and other functions; qualifies as a nature-based infrastructure policy.

The Minister must report annually to Parliament on the status of implementation of international and national obligations to respond to climate change and progress towards the attainment of net zero emissions and climate resilient development.”

source_quote:

Each focal point is responsible for promoting the objectives and principles of this Act within their Ministry, and must report to the Director bi-annually on the implementation of this Act within their ministry.”
extraction_rationale: Creates a mandated administrative structure and recurring reporting duty.

All State entities must review and update relevant decisions made and policies, programmes and processes developed by the State entity prior to the commencement of this section for the purpose of ensuring that the decision, policy, programme or process is consistent with achieving the objectives and the principles of this Act if relevant to the decision, policy, programme or process.”
