policy_statement: Raise public awareness of climate hazards and preparedness through public education campaigns and resources, including developing a public education strategy for natural hazards by March 2024.
source_quote:
“Enable and work with communities, including rural communities, iwi and Māori, organisations and others to make emergency preparedness a part of everyday life through public awareness and advice. Examples are public education campaigns and resources, such as GetReady.govt.nz, and tailored information for those who face additional challenges.

By the end of March 2024, a public education strategy will be developed for natural hazards, and there will be increased availability of information on preparedness for extreme weather events.”
section_header: Chapter 3: Enabling better risk-informed decisions — Action 3.4: Raise awareness of climate hazards and how to prepare
extraction_rationale: This is a specific government action with a deliverable and deadline (public education strategy), aimed at preparedness for climate-exacerbated hazards.

policy_statement: Implement and potentially expand mandatory climate-related financial disclosures, including deciding by 2024 whether to extend requirements to public entities.
source_quote:
“The Financial Sector (Climate-related Disclosures and Other Matters) Amendment Act 2021 requires about 200 of Aotearoa New Zealand's largest financial market participants to analyse and publicly disclose their climate-related risks and opportunities each year. The purpose is to ensure the effects of climate change are routinely considered in decisions for business, investment, lending and insurance.

The Government will decide whether to extend mandatory disclosure requirements to public entities by 2024.”
section_header: Chapter 3: Enabling better risk-informed decisions — Action 3.5: Support high-quality implementation of climate-related disclosures and explore expansion
extraction_rationale: This is a binding regulatory mechanism (statutory disclosure requirement) with an explicit future decision point on expansion; it directly targets climate risk management in finance.

policy_statement: Amend LIM legal requirements to improve natural hazard disclosure for property buyers, with legislative changes likely by end of 2023.
source_quote:
“Changes to legal requirements for Land Information Memoranda (LIMs) will help people make better-informed decisions about natural hazard risk when buying a property. It will give councils greater certainty about what hazard information to include on the LIM.

By end of 2023, legislative changes will likely have been made to the Local Government Official Information and Meetings Act 1987 to provide for improved natural hazard disclosure in LIMs.”
section_header: Chapter 3: Enabling better risk-informed decisions — Action 3.6: Improve natural hazard information on Land Information Memoranda
extraction_rationale: This is a concrete legislative change commitment with a timeframe, aimed at improving hazard-risk information for adaptation-related decisions.

policy_statement: Deliver a rolling programme of targeted adaptation guidance for decision makers to assess and manage climate risks.
source_quote: “The Government will roll out a programme of non-statutory guidance for decision makers to assess and manage climate risks. This could also support regulatory requirements to be developed through the National Planning Framework.”
section_header: Chapter 3: Enabling better risk-informed decisions — Action 3.7: Deliver a rolling programme of targeted adaptation guidance
extraction_rationale: This is an umbrella guidance programme explicitly followed by numbered sub-actions (3.7.1–3.7.8), so it is extracted as a parent policy.

parent_statement: Deliver a rolling programme of targeted adaptation guidance for decision makers to assess and manage climate risks.
policy_statement: Promote use of updated Aotearoa New Zealand Climate Change Projections guidance reflecting AR6 changes to support updated risk management plans.
source_quote:
“3.7.1: Promote the use of the Aotearoa New Zealand Climate Change Projections guidance

An update for Aotearoa that highlights changes from the 2021 AR6 IPCC.12 report. The update will enable stakeholders to quickly assess where they may need to adapt their risk management plans to account for the latest science.”
section_header: Chapter 3: Enabling better risk-informed decisions — Action 3.7.1
extraction_rationale: A specific guidance product with a defined purpose (updating risk management plans) under the parent guidance programme.

parent_statement: Deliver a rolling programme of targeted adaptation guidance for decision makers to assess and manage climate risks.
