parent_statement: Energy Efficiency Program targeting industry, buildings, and land transportation with progressively stringent efficiency standards
policy_statement: Implement aerodynamic regulation for heavy-duty vehicles.
source_quote: Numerous initiatives will be implemented to improve and raise the efficiency of energy consumption in the targeted sectors including improving the efficiency of home appliances and air conditioning units, improving the efficiency of feedstock utilization in key strategic sectors such as petrochemicals, improving transportation fleet fuel economy, phasing out inefficient used light-duty vehicles, implementing aerodynamic regulation for heavyduty vehicles, and improving the thermal efficiency of power generation, transmission, and distribution.
extraction_rationale: Explicit regulatory mechanism ('regulation') to improve freight vehicle efficiency.

parent_statement: Energy Efficiency Program targeting industry, buildings, and land transportation with progressively stringent efficiency standards
policy_statement: Improve thermal efficiency of power generation, transmission, and distribution.
source_quote: Numerous initiatives will be implemented to improve and raise the efficiency of energy consumption in the targeted sectors including improving the efficiency of home appliances and air conditioning units, improving the efficiency of feedstock utilization in key strategic sectors such as petrochemicals, improving transportation fleet fuel economy, phasing out inefficient used light-duty vehicles, implementing aerodynamic regulation for heavyduty vehicles, and improving the thermal efficiency of power generation, transmission, and distribution.
extraction_rationale: Specific efficiency upgrade action in the power system.

policy_statement: Retrofit the entire pool of specified public/government assets and facilities via Tarshid (including 2 million street lights and 110,000 government buildings).
source_quote: The National Energy Services Company (Tarshid) was established to incentivize energy efficiency in government buildings and private sector investment in energy efficiency services. It plans to retrofit the entire pool of public and governmental assets and facilities which include 2 million street lights, 110,000 government buildings, 35,000 public schools, 100,000 mosques, 2,500 hospitals and clinics.
extraction_rationale: Specific, large-scale implementation commitment (retrofit plan) with quantified asset coverage; not merely aspirational.

policy_statement: Achieve around 50% renewable energy in the electricity energy mix by 2030 through the National Renewable Energy Program and associated reforms.
source_quote: Renewable energy projects will contribute to the diversification of the energy mix used in electricity production. Thus, the renewable energy ambition aims to reach around 50% of the energy mix by 2030. Through the National Renewable Energy Program, the Kingdom will implement a set of comprehensive reforms, regulations and policies to stimulate private sector investment, research and development, employment in renewables.
extraction_rationale: Quantified target with timeline plus named program and regulatory reforms; umbrella for multiple implementation elements described in the same subsection.

parent_statement: Achieve around 50% renewable energy in the electricity energy mix by 2030 through the National Renewable Energy Program and associated reforms
policy_statement: Localize a significant portion of the renewable energy value chain in the Saudi economy, including R&D and manufacturing.
source_quote: The program sets out a roadmap to diversify local energy sources, stimulate economic development and establish the local renewable energy supply chain and industry. The Kingdom will seek to localize a significant portion of the renewable energy value chain in the Saudi economy, including research & development and manufacturing.
extraction_rationale: Concrete industrial policy commitment embedded in the renewable program roadmap; supports deployment capacity.

parent_statement: Achieve around 50% renewable energy in the electricity energy mix by 2030 through the National Renewable Energy Program and associated reforms
policy_statement: Deploy renewable and clean energy technologies including solar PV, concentrated solar power, wind, geothermal, waste-to-energy, and green hydrogen.
source_quote: Specific technologies for deployment include solar PV, concentrated solar power, wind, geothermal energy, waste to energy and green hydrogen.
extraction_rationale: Explicit technology deployment commitment (named technologies) under the renewable energy program.

policy_statement: Build NEOM green hydrogen facility powered by over 4 GW of renewables, producing 650 tons/day of green hydrogen by electrolysis once onstream by 2025 (and 1.2 million tons/year of green ammonia).
source_quote: The Kingdom's flagship giga -project, NEOM, will be building one of the world's largest green hydrogen facilities. The plant will be powered by over four gigawatts of renewable energy from solar and wind. Once onstream by 2025, it is expected to produce 650 tons per day of green hydrogen by electrolysis and 1.2 million tons per year of green ammonia.
extraction_rationale: Specific project commitment with quantified capacity/output and timeline; clear mitigation infrastructure investment (though funding not specified).

policy_statement: Transform Jubail and Yanbu into global hubs for carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS).
source_quote: To advance the uptake of CCUS technologies and scale up its deployment, the Kingdom plans to transform Jubail and Yanbu into global hubs for carbon capture, utilization and storage. The hubs will leverage the concentration of the manufacturing industry, proximity to sinks and transport infrastructures.
extraction_rationale: Concrete deployment plan for CCUS at specific locations; a defined intervention to scale mitigation technology.

policy_statement: Develop a National Hydrogen Strategy and prioritize pilots, research and demonstrations to advance blue hydrogen in hard-to-abate sectors.
source_quote: The Kingdom is developing a National Hydrogen Strategy to chart pathways to become a global leader in the hydrogen industry. Pilots, research and demonstrations will be prioritized to improve technology maturity and lower costs in the aviation, shipping, petrochemicals, and steel industries.
extraction_rationale: Named strategy under development plus explicit prioritization of pilots/R&D/demonstrations; sufficiently action-oriented though some details remain broad.

policy_statement: Increase utilization of natural gas in the domestic energy mix so that up to 50% of electricity generation is met by natural gas by 2030.
source_quote: As part of reforms of its domestic energy sector, the Kingdom aims to increase the utilization of natural gas in its energy mix. By 2030, the Kingdom aims that up to 50% of its electricity generation is expected to be met by natural gas significantly lowering the carbon intensity of domestic energy generation.
extraction_rationale: Quantified fuel-switching target with timeline; mitigation via lower-carbon generation (though still fossil-based).

policy_statement: Implement methane management measures in the oil and gas sector including zero flaring and methane recovery and utilization.
source_quote: The methane management measures include zero flaring in the oil and gas industry, recovery and subsequent utilization for power generation and petrochemicals production. The Kingdom as a member of the Global Methane Pledge initiative will collaborate with other members to reduce global methane emissions by 30% by 2030 relative to 2020 levels.
extraction_rationale: Specific interventions (zero flaring; recovery and utilization) constitute concrete mitigation measures; includes an explicit global reduction pledge collaboration.

policy_statement: Collaborate under the Global Methane Pledge to reduce global methane emissions by 30% by 2030 relative to 2020 levels.
source_quote: The methane management measures include zero flaring in the oil and gas industry, recovery and subsequent utilization for power generation and petrochemicals production. The Kingdom as a member of the Global Methane Pledge initiative will collaborate with other members to reduce global methane emissions by 30% by 2030 relative to 2020 levels.
extraction_rationale: Quantified target with timeline (global, via collaboration) is a policy commitment in an international initiative context.

policy_statement: Implement adaptation actions in water and wastewater management to reduce exposure and vulnerability, including steps to reduce energy/GHG impacts of desalination.
source_quote: The Kingdom is taking a number of steps in deploying desalination technologies to minimize the GHG emissions in the form of co-benefits from this sector leading to saving of energy from this sector. These steps include:
extraction_rationale: Umbrella adaptation-with-mitigation-co-benefits initiative followed by lettered sub-actions; qualifies as a parent policy.

parent_statement: Adaptation actions in water and wastewater management (including steps to reduce energy/GHG impacts of desalination)
policy_statement: Gradually replace MSF and MED desalination with lower-energy reverse osmosis (RO) technology.
source_quote: Reverse Osmosis (RO) technology: The Kingdom is gradually replacing the conventional energyintensive multi-stage flash (MSF) and multiple effect distillation (MED) technologies by lower energy consuming RO technology, reducing the energy consumption in this sector. RO is approximately 30% less energy-intensive than the conventional MSF and MED technologies.
extraction_rationale: Specific technology substitution with quantified efficiency comparison; concrete implementation action.

parent_statement: Adaptation actions in water and wastewater management (including steps to reduce energy/GHG impacts of desalination)
policy_statement: Use renewable energy resources (solar, wind, green hydrogen) for seawater desalination in NEOM.
source_quote: Renewable Energy for Seawater Desalination: NEOM city will be using renewable energy resources such as solar, wind and green hydrogen for the seawater desalination for their potable water needs.
extraction_rationale: Specific commitment to power desalination with renewables in a named location; clear mitigation mechanism.

parent_statement: Adaptation actions in water and wastewater management (including steps to reduce energy/GHG impacts of desalination)
policy_statement: Replace old potable water distribution network to minimize leaks and save desalinated potable water.
source_quote: Minimizing Leaks in the Potable Water Distribution System: Old water distribution network will be replaced with a new water distribution network to minimize the leakages in order to save desalinated potable water avoiding increasing the production capacity of the existing plants or avoiding the need for new desalination plants.
extraction_rationale: Concrete infrastructure replacement action to reduce losses; clear resource-efficiency intervention.

parent_statement: Adaptation actions in water and wastewater management (including steps to reduce energy/GHG impacts of desalination)
policy_statement: Expand wastewater collection, treatment and reuse to reduce demand for potable water and groundwater (including for city greening and agriculture).
source_quote: Increasing the use of treated wastewater: The Kingdom is working on expanding the wastewater collection, treatment and reuse to augment the need for potable and groundwater in city greening and in agriculture. This will help reducing the need for potable water (desalinated water) for city greening and groundwater for agriculture.
extraction_rationale: Specific expansion action in wastewater reuse; clearly reduces water demand and supports adaptation to scarcity.

parent_statement: Adaptation actions in water and wastewater management (including steps to reduce energy/GHG impacts of desalination)
policy_statement: Encourage rainwater harvesting to augment potable and irrigation water supply.
source_quote: Rain Water Harvesting: Encouraging rainwater harvesting to augment the need for potable and irrigation water.
extraction_rationale: Specific adaptation measure (rainwater harvesting) stated as an action; somewhat broad but still a named intervention.

parent_statement: Adaptation actions in water and wastewater management (including steps to reduce energy/GHG impacts of desalination)
policy_statement: Increase storage of surface water runoff by constructing new dams.
source_quote: Storage of Surface Water Runoff: Increasing the storage of surface water runoff through constructing new dams in the country.
extraction_rationale: Specific infrastructure intervention (new dams) to manage water availability; adaptation action.

parent_statement: Adaptation actions in water and wastewater management (including steps to reduce energy/GHG impacts of desalination)
policy_statement: Employ new irrigation techniques (e.g., drip, sprinkler, subsurface) to minimize groundwater use in agriculture.
source_quote: New Irrigation Techniques: Employing new irrigation techniques such as surface irrigation, drip irrigation, sprinkler irrigation, subsurface irrigation, and other techniques will minimize the use of and save a substantial amount of precious groundwater used for agriculture.
extraction_rationale: Named set of techniques with clear intended outcome (reduced groundwater use); adaptation/resource-efficiency measure.

policy_statement: Implement coastal management strategies to reduce coastal erosion, increase blue carbon sinks, maintain ecosystems, and address climate-change threats to marine livelihoods.
source_quote: The Kingdom will implement coastal management strategies that are designed to reduce coastal erosion, increase the sinks for blue carbon, maintain related ecosystems and address the threats that climate change poses for marine livelihoods.
extraction_rationale: Explicit commitment to implement strategies with defined objectives; combines adaptation (erosion, livelihoods) and nature-based carbon sinks.

policy_statement: Support planting mangrove seedlings along coasts.
source_quote: The Kingdom supports the planting of mangrove seedlings along its coasts. In addition, the Kingdom strengthens and enhances the coral reef restoration program throughout the northwestern Arabian Gulf.
extraction_rationale: Specific nature-based intervention (mangrove planting) stated as supported action; policy-level commitment though scale is not quantified.

policy_statement: Strengthen and enhance the coral reef restoration program in the northwestern Arabian Gulf, including developing technologies to enhance thermal resilience and scale restoration.
source_quote: The Kingdom strengthens and enhances the coral reef restoration program throughout the northwestern Arabian Gulf. Saudi Arabia's new generation coral reef restoration technologies accelerator aims to develop innovative technologies that enhance the thermal resilience of coral reefs and provide cost-effective options to scale up reef restoration by bringing together national stakeholders.
extraction_rationale: Programmatic commitment to enhance restoration and develop resilience technologies; explicitly addresses thermal resilience (climate impact).

policy_statement: Undertake desertification management measures including stabilizing sand movements with green belts and improving soil, water, pasture and wildlife resources through protected areas and reserves.
source_quote: Saudi Arabia undertakes measures to enhance desertification management: actions that promote the stabilization of sand movements around cities and roads while increasing sinks capacity through using green belts as barriers; develop and enhance arid and semi-arid rural areas through various natural resource conservation activities, biodiversity and ecosystem-based adaptation efforts. The objective is to improve soil quality, water, pasture and wildlife resources through a system of protected areas and reserves.
extraction_rationale: Set of specific ecosystem-based measures with stated objectives; qualifies as adaptation/NBS policy though not quantified.

policy_statement: Plant trees and rehabilitate hectares of land over this decade as part of the Saudi Green Initiative, using recycled water from an irrigation network.
source_quote: Tree planting and rehabilitating hectares of land over this decade as part of the Saudi Green Initiative. Recycled water from an irrigation network will be used for this purpose.
extraction_rationale: Concrete nature-based intervention (tree planting/land rehabilitation) with an implementation detail (recycled water), though the exact hectares are not specified here.

policy_statement: Develop mass transport systems (metro and bus networks) in Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam; operationalize the Riyadh metro and bus network to reduce car journeys and fuel use.
source_quote: The Kingdom is taking actions to develop mass transport systems in urban areas such as the development of the metro and bus network in Riyadh, Jeddah and Dammam, which will provide significant sustainability, environmental and public health benefits. The Kingdom already started construction of metro in Riyadh and in the process of making it operational.
extraction_rationale: Specific infrastructure actions (metro/bus development and operationalization) with clear transport-efficiency and emissions implications.

policy_statement: Expand the Saudi Railway network to connect major cities and ports to reduce traffic and GHG emissions.
source_quote: In addition, Saudi Railway network will be expanded to connect major cities and ports which will result in reductions in traffic and GHG emissions. Approved methodologies will be used to estimate avoided GHG emissions.
extraction_rationale: Clear commitment to expand rail with explicitly stated GHG reduction outcome.

policy_statement: Develop NEOM as a 100% renewable-energy-powered urban model, including the LINE aiming for zero carbon emissions and preserving 95% of nature within NEOM.
source_quote: As an example, NEOM introduces a new model for urban sustainability powered by 100% renewable energy. The project will develop the LINE, a city of a million residents with a length of 170 km that aims to preserve 95% of nature within NEOM, with zero cars, zero streets, zero carbon emissions and to be powered by 100% renewable energy and green hydrogen.
extraction_rationale: Specific project commitments with explicit targets (100% renewables, zero carbon emissions, preserve 95% of nature) and defined development components.

policy_statement: Develop and implement Integrated Coastal Zone Management (ICZM) plans to protect coastal infrastructure.
source_quote: Integrated Coastal Zone Management Planning (ICZM): Take the necessary action to develop and implement ICZM plans that would take into account the protection of coastal infrastructures such as roads, residential areas, industrial complexes, desalination plants, seaports, etc.;
extraction_rationale: Explicit commitment to develop and implement plans; clear adaptation planning intervention.

policy_statement: Develop and operationalize early warning systems to reduce vulnerability to extreme weather events (rainstorms, floods, dust storms) by increasing infrastructure resilience.
source_quote: Early Warning Systems (EWS): Develop and operationalize EWS that would reduce vulnerability due to extreme weather events such as rainstorms, floods and dust storms by increasing resilience of infrastructure;
extraction_rationale: Specific adaptation system (EWS) with explicit hazards; concrete operational commitment.

policy_statement: Implement the Saudi National Water Strategy 2030 to reform the water and wastewater sector and ensure sustainable development of water resources and affordable high-quality services.
source_quote: The Saudi National Water Strategy 2030 aims to work towards addressing all the key challenges, leveraging previous and on-going studies, and reform the water and wastewater sector to ensure sustainable development of water resources while providing affordable high-quality services. Strategic programs and initiatives include laws and regulations, management, innovation and capacity building, and service quality.
extraction_rationale: Named national strategy with stated aims and implementation levers (laws/regulations, management, innovation, capacity building).

policy_statement: Put in place policies to make cities and infrastructure more sustainable by improving building efficiency and resilience to heatwaves.
source_quote: Infrastructure and Cities Designs: Put in place the necessary policies to make cities and infrastructure more sustainable. Improving the cities design by increasing the efficiency of buildings by making them more resilient to heatwaves.
extraction_rationale: Explicit policy commitment tied to a named climate hazard (heatwaves) and a specific mechanism (building efficiency/resilience), though details are high-level.

policy_statement: Conduct socio-economic research studies to assess impacts of mitigation policies implemented outside Saudi Arabia on the Saudi economy, including data and modelling tools.
source_quote: The Kingdom is actively engaged in the following: i. Socio-economic research studies to assess the impacts of mitigation policy measures implemented outside Saudi Arabia on the Saudi economy, including data and modelling tools.
extraction_rationale: Specific ongoing action (research studies) as part of managing response measures; climate-relevant but not directly mitigation/adaptation.

policy_statement: Undertake R&D of technologies that enhance economic competitiveness in the context of response measures.
source_quote: The Kingdom is actively engaged in the following: ii. Research and development of technologies that enhance economic competitiveness.
extraction_rationale: Stated action (R&D) but vague on climate mechanism; included as response-measures policy with limited specificity.

policy_statement: Pursue technology cooperation to identify appropriate technological options consistent with national priorities and resources (including CCUS) to promote enabling environment for economic diversification and technological development.
source_quote: Technology cooperation based on the approaches outlined in paragraphs 24-29 in decision 5/CP.7 will allow for the identification of appropriate technological options, which are consistent with national priorities, and domestic human and financial resources to promote enabling environment for economic diversification and technological development (e.g., carbon capture utilization and storage).
extraction_rationale: Commitment to technology cooperation with an explicit example (CCUS); still broad but constitutes a deliberate policy approach.

policy_statement: Research long-term impacts of response measures on energy market stability and develop measures to sustain a stable energy market.
source_quote: Research into understanding the long-term impacts of response measures on energy market stability and to develop measures that can sustain a stable energy market in the long run.
extraction_rationale: Specific research-and-measures commitment; climate link is via response measures rather than emissions/resilience outcomes.

policy_statement: Support the Saudi Green Initiative as a national initiative contributing toward achieving the Kingdom’s climate ambitions.
source_quote: Launched in 2021, the Saudi Green Initiative contributes towards achieving the climate ambitions of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. As a national initiative, it aims at improving the quality of life and protecting future generations.
extraction_rationale: Named national initiative explicitly linked to climate ambitions; however, this excerpt lacks specific quantified actions (those appear elsewhere), so it is a higher-level policy anchor.

policy_statement: Implement the Circular Carbon Economy (CCE) approach using the 4Rs (reduce, reuse, recycle, remove) to manage GHG emissions.
source_quote: The Circular Carbon Economy (CCE) approach consist of the ' 4Rs ' model of reduce, reuse, recycle, and remove to manage GHG emissions: Reduce: reduce emissions through sustainable consumption, enhanced efficiencies, including fuel efficiencies, cleaner energy systems, electrification and renewables, and improving energy and process efficiencies
extraction_rationale: Explicit framework to manage GHG emissions with defined levers; functions as a policy approach guiding mitigation actions.

policy_statement: Prioritize deployment and collaboration on CCUS, direct-air capture (DAC), and clean hydrogen as crucial technologies for Paris Agreement goals.
source_quote: Given their abatement potential, deployment of and collaboration on the following technologies is crucial: carbon capture, utilization and storage (CCUS), direct-air capture (DAC), clean hydrogen. In climate adaptation, the following technologies are prioritized: (a) water saving, recycling, capture, irrigation and sustainable management for agriculture purposes and (b) early warning system against meteorological extreme events (such as floods, sandstorms and droughts).
extraction_rationale: Clear prioritization of specific mitigation technologies for deployment/collaboration; constitutes a technology policy direction.

policy_statement: Prioritize adaptation technologies including water saving/recycling/capture/irrigation/sustainable management for agriculture and early warning systems for extreme events (floods, sandstorms, droughts).
source_quote: In climate adaptation, the following technologies are prioritized: (a) water saving, recycling, capture, irrigation and sustainable management for agriculture purposes and (b) early warning system against meteorological extreme events (such as floods, sandstorms and droughts). The Kingdom has prioritized international technology cooperation and technology transfer at both public and private sector levels.
extraction_rationale: Explicit prioritization of adaptation technology areas and hazards; actionable direction though not quantified.

policy_statement: Support operationalization of Paris Agreement Article 6 mechanisms and completion of rules required for Article 6 operationalization.
source_quote: Therefore, the Kingdom reaffirms its support for the completion of rules required for Article 6 operationalization.
section_header: 8.4 ARTICLE 6 VOLUNTARY COOPERATION, APPROACHES AND MECHANISM
extraction_rationale: Clear international policy position/commitment to support rule completion enabling carbon market cooperation; not a domestic regulation but a climate policy stance.

policy_statement: Maintain and operate a national monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) system to track progress toward NDC projects and plans.
source_quote: Established and managed by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Designated National Authority, the national MRV system is an integral part of the existing and future monitoring and reporting structures. The MRV system tracks the progress towards achieving NDC projects and plans and any modifications thereof.
section_header: 9. MONITORING AND REPORTING ON NDC IMPLEMENTATION
extraction_rationale: Institutional implementation mechanism (MRV) with a defined function; supports accountability for climate actions.
